rubric.role_summary: Fleet sales account manager responsible for consultative, end-to-end sales of configurable electric vehicles to organizational customers, including proposals, negotiation, delivery relationships, and repeat business.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Fleet sales account manager responsible for consultative, end-to-end sales of configurable electric vehicles to organizational customers, including proposals, negotiation, delivery relationships, and repeat business.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years in B2B sales or account management.
- Experience in a quota-carrying role owning deals end to end.
- Experience selling technical products.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience selling considered, higher-ACV products.
- Experience selling to fleets, enterprises, or the public sector.
- Experience selling vehicles, capital equipment, or fleet/commercial products.
- Familiarity with HubSpot.
- Interest in EVs and specialty vehicles.
- Track record owning deals end to end and hitting quota.
- Consultative selling skills, including comfort with technical products and multi-stakeholder deals.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Detroit, MI area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
